title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: uplift and discount act one after the other on the premium
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line fixes how the goods-category uplift and the contract discount combine when the premium of a bound cover is built up.

## Rule

1. The base premium is increased by the uplift percent, giving the gross premium.
2. The gross premium is then reduced by the discount percent.
3. The uplift and the discount act one after the other, each on the figure of the step before, and are never combined into one rate.

## Hypothetical worked example

Hypothetical figures: base premium 1,000.00, uplift 30 percent, discount 5 percent.

| Step | Working | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| Uplift on the base premium | 1,000.00 increased by 30 percent | 1,300.00 |
| Discount on the gross premium | 1,300.00 reduced by 5 percent | 1,235.00 |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- *Wrong reading:* net the rates first, 30 percent less 5 percent making 25 percent, and apply 25 percent to 1,000.00, giving 1,250.00. *Correct basis:* the discount acts on the gross premium of 1,300.00, giving 1,235.00.
- *Wrong reading:* apply the discount to the base premium and add the uplift separately. *Correct basis:* each step acts on the figure produced by the step before.
